name: Ewyn Universe
storyline:
In a harsh medieval world shaped by rival kingdoms, political struggles, and the pursuit of power, every journey begins somewhere.

Ewyn Universe places players in the role of an impoverished wanderer, starting with nothing but the determination to change their fate. Cast out by a city guard, they must find their own path in a vast and unforgiving world.

Beyond the city walls lie sprawling forests, forgotten castles, thriving settlements, and territories contested by powerful kingdoms. Survival depends on the choices players make, the alliances they forge, and the battles they fight.
summary:
Ewyn Universe is an open-world medieval MMORPG set in an original low-fantasy universe. Players can explore a persistent world, engage in skill-based action combat, gather resources, craft equipment, and participate in a player-driven economy.

The game features a classless progression system, allowing players to develop their characters through attributes, talents, weapons, and professions. Combat includes melee weapons, archery, mounted combat, and directional defensive mechanics. Players can join kingdoms, form guilds, conquer territories, and influence the political and economic landscape through warfare, trade, and cooperation.
